content: वेणिः, -णी {%f.%} [वेण्-इन्-वा डीप् <ls>Uṇ. 4. 18</ls>] .²1 Braided hair, a braid of hair; तरङ्गिणी वेणिरिवायता भुवः <ls>Śi. 12. 75</ls>; <ls>Me. 18</ls>. .²2 Hair twisted into a single unornamented braid and allowed to fall on the back (said to be worn by women whose husbands are absent from them); वनान्निवृत्तेन रघूत्तमेन मुक्ता स्वयं वेणिरिवावभासे <ls>R. 14. 12</ls>; अबलावेणिमोक्षोत्सुकानि <ls>Me. 101</ls>; <ls>Ku. 2. 61</ls>. .²3 Continuous flow, current, stream; जलवेणिरम्यां रेवां यदि प्रेक्षितुमस्ति कामः <ls>R. 6. 43</ls>; <ls>Me. 20</ls>; प्रवृत्तबाष्पवेणिकं चक्षुः प्रमृज्य <ls>K.</ls>; <ab>cf.</ab> the word त्रिवेणि also. .²4 The confluence of two or more rivers. .²5 The confluence of the Ganges, Yamunā and Sarasvatī. .²6 <ab>N.</ab> of a river. .²7 The property re-united after it has been before divided. .²8 A cascade. .²9 A dam, bridge. .²10 A ewe.
